covered_behavior: dev_iq2_xxs_dot_f32 table-indexed packed gate and up decode
moe_gate_up_mid_f32_kernel, moe_down_f32_kernel, and moe_sum_kernel fallback launches

hyperconnection kernels, runtime graph integration, default route, and C CUDA removal
